newsitem.title: SPAIN: Financial markets in Madrid closed for holiday.
newsitem.headline: Financial markets in Madrid closed for holiday.

text.p: 1030 GMT - Financial markets in Madrid were closed on Thursday for Maundy Thursday public holiday in Spain, but Catalonia and Valencia regions are working normally.
Markets will also be closed on Friday and will reopen on Monday.
Closing levels on Wednesday were as follows:
* June bond future 111.41 vs 111.65 at Tuesday's close.
